purpose: Inspect all GW008 World Cup results to identify season 1 final
sql: SELECT sm_fixture_id,match_date,competition_stage,competition_round,home_name,away_name,home_score,away_score,penalty_home_score,penalty_away_score FROM `GW008_IMC Results` WHERE game_world_id='GW008' AND competition_key='GW008|NATIONS|worldcup' ORDER BY match_date,sm_fixture_id
